articles.title: Japan's 20-year bond yield falls sharply after strongest auction on record
articles.content: Japan's 20-year government bond yield saw a notable decline following a record demand from its recent auction. This drop marked the lowest yield since early September, driven by investor confidence in the Bank of Japan's interest rate stability. The strong auction signals a cautious sentiment among investors, influenced by recent global developments. Other bond yields mirrored this downward trend, showcasing broader market behaviors.

articles.title: Bank of Japan may raise inflation forecast, stand pat on rates, sources say
articles.content: The Bank of Japan plans to slightly upgrade its fiscal year 2027 inflation forecasts this month. Interest rates are expected to remain stable at 1.25% during the upcoming policy meeting in late October. While inflation risks are present, there is no immediate urgency for further rate hikes. Recent data indicates that inflationary pressures are not escalating significantly at this time.

articles.title: Yen jumps after JGB auction draws big demand, euro finds relief
articles.content: The yen experienced a notable rise against the dollar, driven by unprecedented demand for long-term Japanese government bonds. In France, curfews were enacted in response to widespread anti-government protests, which pose challenges for President Emmanuel Macron's administration. Meanwhile, the euro gained momentum alongside a rise in European bond futures amid persistent political uncertainties in France and Italy.

articles.title: Warren Buffett warned about stock valuations but Berkshire Hathaway is aggressively purchasing stocks
articles.content: While Buffett criticised the current market scenario, his firm Berkshire Hathaway has been pumping up its investments. The company under CEO Greg Abel has been increasing its stake in Google-parent Alphabet, making it one of Berkshire's five largest common stock holdings, led by iPhone maker Apple. Berkshire more than tripled its stake in Alphabet and purchased over $2.6 billion worth of shares in Delta Air Lines after Abel formally took over as chief executive from Warren Buffett at the start of the year.
